note: Machine-readable evaluation contract, and the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the experiment. gate.mjs loads its criteria from here and research/experiment.mjs resolves every data/risk/cost/regime parameter from here — nothing is read from a literal in code or from a command-line flag. Changing any value changes protocol_hash, which is recorded in every run, and every record also carries experiment_fingerprint so a record can never claim a protocol it was not run under. CLI flags that name a parameter are accepted only when they REPRODUCE the value below; a flag that departs from it is refused. That is deliberate: you should not be able to move a threshold, or the data window, or the position sizing, after seeing results, without it being visible.
